section: Vizag Railway Zone - promise, status and issues
subsections: Railway infrastructure promises in AP - Amaravati rail link, new lines under the Act

accepted.s: The proposed Amaravati rail link is associated with which of the following projects?
accepted.x: The proposed Amaravati rail link is the new Errupalem–Namburu broad-gauge line.
accepted.tq: Identify the project by matching its stated purpose with the correct railway line.
accepted.sec: Railway infrastructure promises in AP - Amaravati rail link, new lines under the Act

accepted.s: The approximate length of the proposed Errupalem–Namburu broad-gauge line is:
accepted.x: The Errupalem–Namburu line is approximately 57 km long.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the specific project length from nearby railway figures.
accepted.sec: Railway infrastructure promises in AP - Amaravati rail link, new lines under the Act

accepted.s: The proposed Amaravati rail link includes a bridge of approximately what length over the Krishna River?
accepted.x: The project includes an approximately 3 km bridge over the Krishna River.
accepted.tq: Use the project-specific numerical figure rather than the total line length.
accepted.sec: Railway infrastructure promises in AP - Amaravati rail link, new lines under the Act

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding land arrangements for the Amaravati rail link:
1. Farmers of Tadikonda and Mothadaka opted for land pooling.
2. A 100-metre buffer for the railway line was incorporated into the Amaravati Inner Ring Road land pooling.
3. The railway line was planned without any provision in the Inner Ring Road land pooling.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Farmers of Tadikonda and Mothadaka opted for land pooling, and a 100-metre buffer was built into the Amaravati Inner Ring Road land pooling. Statement 3 is false because such a buffer was provided.
accepted.tq: Find the statement that reverses the stated land-pooling arrangement.
accepted.sec: Railway infrastructure promises in AP - Amaravati rail link, new lines under the Act

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the high-speed rail proposals is correct?
o: The 2026–27 Budget named seven high-speed rail growth connectors, including Hyderabad–Bengaluru, Hyderabad–Chennai and Chennai–Bengaluru.
The 2026–27 Budget named five high-speed rail growth connectors, excluding all southern corridors.
Amaravati–Hyderabad was proposed as a seven-hour high-speed rail journey.
Only Amaravati–Hyderabad was identified as a high-speed rail growth connector.
accepted.x: The 2026–27 Budget identified seven high-speed rail growth connectors, including the three listed southern corridors. Amaravati–Hyderabad was proposed to be covered in 70 minutes, not seven hours.
accepted.tq: Separate the complete list-based statement from options that alter the count or travel time.
accepted.sec: Railway infrastructure promises in AP - Amaravati rail link, new lines under the Act

accepted.s: Amaravati–Hyderabad high-speed rail connectivity was proposed to cover the distance in approximately:
accepted.x: The proposed Amaravati–Hyderabad high-speed rail journey was stated as 70 minutes.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact travel-time figure associated with the proposal.
accepted.sec: Railway infrastructure promises in AP - Amaravati rail link, new lines under the Act

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer.

List-I (Railway project)
a. Nadikudi–Srikalahasti
b. Kotipalli–Narsapur
c. Ramayapatnam–Kadapa

a List-II (Description)
i. Dedicated line for a steel plant
ii. Railway line associated with the backward districts of Guntur, Prakasam, Nellore and Chittoor
iii. Railway line referred to as another proposed line in Andhra Pradesh

Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: Nadikudi–Srikalahasti is associated with the four backward districts; Kotipalli–Narsapur is another railway line; and Ramayapatnam–Kadapa has a dedicated line approved for a steel plant.

accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact route length from nearby numerical distractors.

Kadapa, Kurnool, Nellore and West Godavari

accepted.s:
With reference to railway investment in Andhra Pradesh during 2026–27, consider the following statements:
1. The railway outlay for Andhra Pradesh was ₹10,134 crore.
2. The average railway outlay during 2009–14 was ₹886 crore.
3. The 2026–27 outlay was lower than the average outlay during 2009–14.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The 2026–27 outlay was ₹10,134 crore, compared with an average of ₹886 crore during 2009–14. Therefore, Statement 3 is false because the later outlay was substantially higher.
accepted.tq: Compare the two outlay figures and reject the reversed comparison.
accepted.sec: Railway infrastructure promises in AP - Amaravati rail link, new lines under the Act

accepted.s: As of 1 April 2026, which one of the following combinations relating to railway projects in Andhra Pradesh was correct?
o: 74 projects, 4,768 km, ₹77,855 crore sanctioned and 1,465 km commissioned
42 projects, 1,465 km, ₹10,134 crore sanctioned and 4,768 km commissioned
42 projects, 4,768 km, ₹77,855 crore sanctioned and 1,465 km commissioned
42 projects, 7,855 km, ₹77,855 crore sanctioned and 1,134 km commissioned
accepted.x: As of 1 April 2026, 42 projects covering 4,768 km had ₹77,855 crore sanctioned, while 1,465 km had been commissioned.
accepted.tq: Keep the project count, route length, sanctioned amount and commissioned length in their correct positions.
accepted.sec: Railway infrastructure promises in AP - Amaravati rail link, new lines under the Act

accepted.s: What was the status of electrification of the railway network in Andhra Pradesh as stated for 2026?
accepted.x: The railway network in Andhra Pradesh was stated to be 100% electrified.
accepted.tq: Test the completion status directly and avoid confusing it with the length commissioned.
accepted.sec: Railway infrastructure promises in AP - Amaravati rail link, new lines under the Act

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Amrit Bharat Stations in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Seventy-four stations in Andhra Pradesh were selected under the programme.
2. Sullurupeta station is near Sriharikota.
3. Sullurupeta station was opened on 22 May 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: 74 stations were selected, Sullurupeta is near Sriharikota, and it was opened on 22 May 2025.
accepted.tq: Verify the count, location and date together before selecting the complete combination.
accepted.sec: Railway infrastructure promises in AP - Amaravati rail link, new lines under the Act

accepted.s: The South Coast Railway (SCoR) became India’s 18th railway zone on:
accepted.x: SCoR became India’s 18th railway zone on 1 June 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the formation date from the dates associated with Metro Railway and Sullurupeta station.

accepted.s: Which one of the following was identified as the 17th railway zone before SCoR became the 18th zone?
accepted.x: Metro Railway, Kolkata, was the 17th zone and dates from 29 December 2010, before SCoR became the 18th zone.
accepted.tq: Use the first-and-last comparison to identify the immediately preceding zone.

accepted.s:
Which of the following has been cited as a criticism or issue associated with the creation of the new railway zone in Andhra Pradesh?
1. A decade of delay
2. Ceding of the K-K line and Waltair revenue to Odisha
3. Staff shortages

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The criticisms included a decade of delay, the ceding of the K-K line and Waltair revenue to Odisha, and staff shortages.
accepted.tq: Check whether each listed issue belongs to the same criticism cluster before choosing the complete combination.

accepted.s: A dedicated railway zone in Andhra Pradesh is expected to support the Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor primarily by:
o: Increasing passenger fares and reducing industrial traffic
Transferring all railway revenue to Odisha
Replacing electrified railway lines with road transport
Cutting freight costs and improving port connectivity
accepted.x: The dedicated zone is expected to cut freight costs for the Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor and improve port connectivity.
accepted.tq: Link the institutional reform to its stated economic and logistics outcomes.

accepted.s: The proposed role of the new railway zone as a “multimodal logistics hub” is most closely connected with which objective?
o: Reducing the number of railway projects in Andhra Pradesh
Integrating freight movement and port connectivity
Shifting all railway administration to Metro Railway, Kolkata
Restricting railway services to passenger traffic
accepted.x: The multimodal logistics hub concept refers to integrated freight movement and improved connectivity with ports, particularly in relation to the industrial corridor.
accepted.tq: Interpret the functional meaning of a logistics-hub label from its stated economic context.
